transcript.content: Hello, please have a seat. What brings you in to see me today?

Thanks. Well, what brings me in is... I just keep messing up little things. It's getting a bit frustrating. Like, I'll write down the wrong time on a class sheet down at the senior center. Or I'll be working on a project, measure a board once, and still end up cutting it a hair short because I skipped over the small print on the tape measure. It's just little details like that I keep missing.
When did you first start noticing these problems with missing details?
Well, I'd say it's been noticeably interfering since we moved into our condo. That was about a year and a month ago. That's when I really started picking up on it getting in the way of things.
How has your mood or overall outlook been over the past year?

My mood? It's been fine, mostly. I mean, I'm not depressed or down or anything like that. Overall, I'd say my outlook is pretty good. I just get a little annoyed with myself when I keep making those silly mistakes, but other than that bit of frustration, I feel okay.
Are you still able to manage your everyday responsibilities, like handling finances or medications, on your own without needing help?

Oh, yeah, I manage all that just fine. I don't need any help with the bills or taking my pills or anything like that. I handle the finances just like I always have. It's really just... well, like I said, it's just those little careless mistakes that trip me up. But the big everyday responsibilities, I can handle all those on my own without any trouble.
Do you have any medical conditions or chronic health problems?
No, I don't have any medical conditions or chronic health problems. I've been pretty healthy, overall. No major issues to speak of.
Have you ever experienced a head injury, a concussion, or any neurological events like a stroke?
No, I haven't. I've never had a concussion or any kind of bad head injury... and definitely no strokes. Like I said, I've been pretty lucky with my health overall, so, no, none of that.
Have you noticed any trouble with your memory, such as forgetting recent conversations or misplacing things more often?

Well, I don't think my memory is bad, like forgetting conversations or anything like that. But I do misplace things quite a bit. I spend more time than I should hunting for my keys, or my reading glasses... or my tape measure. Even the little bag of supplies I use for my card games. I'll be looking all over for them, even when I just had them in my hand a few minutes before. It's frustrating, but it's more about losing track of things than actually forgetting.
Do you feel easily drained or mentally fatigued when you have to concentrate on a task?

No, I wouldn't say so. I don't really get drained or... mentally fatigued, like you said. I mean, I might lose my train of thought sometimes, but trying to concentrate doesn't leave me feeling tired or wiped out. So, no, I haven't noticed that.
Looking back to when you were a child or in school, did you ever have trouble paying attention or tend to make careless mistakes back then?

Yeah, I did. Even back in elementary school, I remember my teachers writing notes about it on my report cards. They'd say I was a bright kid, but I was always forgetting my books or losing my homework. And... I'd just sit there staring out the window, really, unless someone was right there to keep me on track. So, yes, I definitely had trouble with that back then.
